_readme: The three acceptance documents (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-09-22, plan Sec.4). `record.root` is `library` (resolved via tools.library.score_library.library_root(), which follows a worktree back to the main checkout) or `repo` (resolved against the git root). `record.md5` is a RECEIPT: null until tools.omr.acceptance runs once, after which it is written back here and every later run must match it or the command refuses loudly -- a shared record under library/_shared-records/ is machine-local and gitignored, so this receipt is the only way a later run (or a different machine) can tell whether the input under a committed id silently changed. `count_page.pdf_page_index` and `works_row_id` are the cleanup-count pages named in DECISIONS.md. `truth` is populated only for the engraved document, which has an exact page truth from Verovio; the two scans have no truth file and are scored only by the machine proxies plus Sean's periodic count.

documents.label: Brahms 1 mvt 1, Breitkopf 317803 (scan, SHATTERING plate)
caveats: Whole movement, pdf pages 0-26 (27 pages). The movement boundary was VERIFIED against the plate, not assumed: pdf page 27 opens 'Andante sostenuto', which is movement 2, so movement 1 ends at page 26.

Gathered 2026-09-23 on commit 275641c0 with a clean tree, 1 h 11 m wall (GATHER ~28 min, ADJUDICATE ~33 min, GROUPS+EVALUATE ~5 min, INFER+EXPORT the rest) -- the first whole-movement run after roadmap 1.2 bounded the deciding stages.
SUPERSEDES the 4-page p0-p3 record this entry pointed at (_shared-records/brahms1-breitkopf-p0-p3-ink.record.json), which stays on disk.

documents.label: Beethoven 5 mvt 1 bars 1-24, Verovio render, 18 parts (engraved, exact page truth)

record.note: RE-GATHERED 2026-09-23 on f48a59ce with a CLEAN tree (roadmap 2.9). The record this replaced, benchmarks/omr-staged-engraved-2026-09/out/engraved-p0p2.record.json (md5 d349e3631f3a1737aa6fc2f15c13b374), was gathered on 7754d277 with dirty=True and BEFORE the document-identity work, so it carries no Q.INPUT_DOMAIN row at all -- roadmap 2.2's engraved-template tier could not fire on the acceptance page and 0 of 54 key verdicts read `fitted_by_template_engraved`. A record from a dirty tree is not a baseline (CLAUDE.md Sec.4b); this one is. The superseded file stays on disk. benchmarks/omr-key-majority-2026-09/FINDINGS.md Sec.1a.

count_page.note: bar range for pdf page 0 is from benchmarks/omr-staged-engraved-2026-09/run_all.sh's own comment: grep -c 'class="measure"' fixture-p{1,2,3}.svg -> 7 / 9 / 8
